notes.title: TRAFFIC is now FREE TO PLAY
notes.content:
Hey guys, it's been about two years since this game came out and I've decided to make this game free to play for a few reasons. 

[olist]
[*] It has been about two years and think that's a good amount of time to release something for everyone to enjoy. 
[*] It's a good opportunity for people that enjoy this game to follow me and my newer projects.
[*] It allows everyone who plays this game to give general feedback and I think that's going to be essential in polishing whatever 'style' it is I'm trying to go for.  
[/olist]
Thanks for all the support up until now. There haven't been very many comments but there have been a surprising number of purchases so I really appreciate that. 

I'm also working on a supporters update that will include some new stuff, but I figured I'd give you guys a chance to beat the game first.

Enjoy the world of TRAFFIC and make sure to follow me here and on my social medias for future projects.

Thanks again!

notes.title: TRAFFIC v1.07 Final Patch
notes.content:
Alright guys, this is officially the last patch for this game (unless something really bad happens or until the VR Edition starts being developed)

Here are the super important changes:
[list]
[*] Performance optimization, max fps set to 60 to avoid unlimited framerate issues.
[*] Added light switch tip so players realize there are light switches in the house they can switch on.
[*] Made the Halloween Event a little bit easier since it was still pretty tough.
[*] Made the pumpkin in the main menu fly away because it's not Halloween anymore but he's still a pretty cool guy.
[*] Added a link to a trailer for my new game, 'I REMEMBER' on the Main Menu.
[/list]
And that's all. Please go Wishlist my new game 'I REMEMBER', it's already on Steam and will be releasing in March. 

Or click here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2317170/I_REMEMBER/]'I REMEMBER' Steam Page[/url]

Thanks!

notes.title: Price Reduction and Moving Forward!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

It's been a few months since the release of TRAFFIC so I've decided to permanently reduce the price and start marketing for my next project. 

I've added a lot to this game since its' initial release and I'd still like to add controller support but I've got quite a bit going on right now so that'll be on hold for a while longer. As thanks to everyone who played TRAFFIC I've attached a screenshot teaser of my next project which should be releasing in March 2023. If you enjoyed TRAFFIC consider following my social media stuff for further announcements! (: 

Thanks again!

notes.title: TRAFFIC Halloween Event
notes.content:
Taking place on Halloween, a lone child trick-or-treating comes across the TRAFFIC home. They knock on the door and a familiar face answers. They offer you some candy; all you need to do is step inside the house and take some. Think you're brave enough?

This event will have multiple endings, new mechanics, scares, music, and replayability. It will be a free and permanent addition to the game that can be accessed at any time, even after Halloween is over. 

It'll be crazy, it'll be stupid, it'll be a lot of fun.
